prompt_text: Who is the best mortgage lender in St. Charles MO for a home purchase loan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” lender—the right choice depends on your credit, down payment, loan type, and how much you value local service. **Guild Mortgage’s St. Charles office** is a reasonable local lender to include in your comparison: it offers purchase loans, including VA loans, and local customer reviews mention responsive service. [Guild Mortgage St. Charles](https://branches.guildmortgage.com/mo/weldonspring/st-charles-158.html) · [Office reviews](https://www.experience.com/reviews/office/st-charles-127891)

I’d also get a quote from **Integrity Mortgage of Missouri**, a local lender with positive customer feedback, and from your bank or credit union. [Integrity Mortgage](https://integritymo.com/)

Compare at least three **Loan Estimates** for the same loan amount, down payment, rate-lock period, and loan type. Look at the **APR, lender fees, points, and estimated cash to close**, not just the advertised interest rate. Ask each lender how quickly they can issue a preapproval and whether they regularly close on time in St. Charles County.
